issues_fixed.name: Multi-turn memory broken in all cortices
issues_fixed.fix: Created /app/backend/modules/freebuild/orchestrator/shared_memory.py with load_memory/save_memory/memory_to_system_hint/history_to_messages. Each LLM cortex now: (1) loads project memory at top, (2) injects past_outputs + brand_dna + glossary into system prompt as Arabic hint, (3) injects recent history as a context block in the user message (avoiding LlmChat role-replay deadlocks), (4) saves outputs to `freebuild_project_memory` MongoDB collection with output_excerpt[:300] for next-turn recall.
issues_fixed.live_verification: Turn A asked AI to write slogan for 'مخبأ_1782553414'. Turn B asked 'ما اسم المتجر؟'. AI replied '**مخبأ**' from memory hint. DB shows 8 past_outputs with output_excerpt populated.

issues_fixed.name: VideoCortex auto_refunded always (broken _FakeCtx + wrong param name)
issues_fixed.fix: Rebuilt the FakeCtx with all required fields (auth_token, is_owner, db, messages_log, tool_log, async emit). Changed `description` → `prompt` to match workflow_tools.generate_video signature. Added internal error capture so error_for_user from provider surfaces to client.
issues_fixed.live_verification: Now invokes fal.ai hailuo correctly with proper ctx; emits provider_error step when key/model issue occurs instead of silent fallback.

issues_fixed.name: Multi-domain coordination shared_assets ignored by CodeCortex
issues_fixed.fix: CodeCortex already prepends `📦 أصول جاهزة` block when shared_assets is provided. Memory layer adds another channel — past_outputs now persists across cortices so a logo URL generated in Turn 1 surfaces in Turn 2's narrative cortex automatically via memory_to_system_hint.

issues_fixed.name: Library Registry underused in production (3/45 libs)
issues_fixed.fix: Added critical-priority lesson (id=1e4188f8-...): 'عند طلب أي عنصر يطابق Capability Atlas → استدع inject_library فوراً. لا تكتب <script src=cdn...> يدوياً.' Now retrieved by lesson_retrieval.py RAG when keyword match.

issues_fixed.name: Trade Secret scrubber not applied to cortex outputs
issues_fixed.fix: Imported scrub_customer_text from ...trade_secret in narrative, visual, video cortices. Applied to `summary` field of `done` events before yielding. Audio cortex is already safe (snippet is pre-canned).

issues_fixed.name: No per-cortex rate limiting (runaway cost risk)
issues_fixed.fix: Created /app/backend/modules/freebuild/orchestrator/rate_limit.py with in-memory sliding-window. Defaults: visual=10/min, video=3/min, audio=20/min, narrative=30/min, code=60/min. Owner overrides via ZENREX_CORTEX_RATE_LIMIT_<CORTEX>_PER_MIN env. Orchestrator checks BEFORE invoking the cortex and emits `cortex_rate_limited` + auto_refunded `done` event.

issues_fixed.name: VisualCortex used only gpt-image-1, ignored Nano Banana (cheaper + better)
issues_fixed.fix: Added `_generate_with_nano_banana()` using GeminiImageGeneration / OpenAIImageGeneration fallback with model='gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview'. Pipeline is now: Nano Banana → gpt-image-1 → fal.ai/flux/schnell. Emits per-step cortex_step events so user knows which provider succeeded.

issues_fixed.name: Brand DNA / Style Memory missing — each image generated in isolation
issues_fixed.fix: shared_memory.py stores `brand_dna` (palette/tone/voice), `style_seed`, `glossary`. memory_to_system_hint injects these into every cortex call. AI can now request consistency across batches of images by storing seed.
